control_model.carrier: degree-zero cycles Z0 of a unital differential graded star-algebra (A,Q), modulo degree-zero boundaries B0=Q(A^-1)
control_model.domain: algebraic degree-zero cohomology; no analytic completion, field-theory domain or GU source differential is supplied
control_model.observable_control: a two-summand real 4x4 matrix star-algebra whose second summand is the exact boundary ideal and whose quotient is the first summand
control_model.ownership: repository-owned downstream-demand control, not a source/action-owned GU BRST or BFV observable algebra

cohomology_descent.ideal_theorem: because Q is a graded derivation, B0=Q(A^-1) is a two-sided ideal in Z0=ker(Q) intersect A0; star compatibility makes it a star ideal
cohomology_descent.observable_algebra: H0_Q=Z0/B0 therefore carries a well-defined unital star product and involution
cohomology_descent.state_iff: a normalized positive functional omega on Z0 descends uniquely to H0_Q iff omega annihilates every degree-zero boundary
cohomology_descent.local_relations: self-adjointness, involution squares and Alice-Bob commutators need hold modulo B0; their classes then satisfy the exact relations
cohomology_descent.sos_descent: the K83 CHSH sum-of-squares identity is well-defined and positive on H0_Q once the quotient state and local classes exist

finite_control.differential: A^-1 is the boundary ideal as a Z0-bimodule, A^-2=0, negative-negative products vanish, and Q is the identity inclusion A^-1 to B0; the graded Leibniz rule follows from the bimodule actions
finite_control.positive_state: the real Bell-vector state on the first summand annihilates the boundary ideal and saturates CHSH at 2*sqrt(2)
finite_control.non_descent_control: a normalized positive mixture with nonzero weight on the boundary summand assigns different values to equivalent representatives and cannot descend
